summary.zh: 设定配色与字体，保证正文对比度达标
summary.en: Set brand colors and fonts that pass WCAG AA contrast

description.zh: 用十个问题确定文档的品牌配色、标题与正文字体、整体风格和目录形式，作为后续 markdown 转 HTML 的统一外观。配色会按 WCAG AA 校验正文与链接的对比度，不达标时拒绝保存并给出修改建议。适合第一次做文档转换前设定样式，或品牌更新后调整。
description.en: Ten-question onboarding for document brand colors, heading and body fonts, style and table of contents, applied by later markdown-to-HTML conversions. Palettes failing WCAG AA contrast are rejected.
